selector_version: Preserved execution-time selectors per run; excludes experimental conflict-policy trials

definitions.outcomes: Rates are fractions [0,1], counts divided by all attempts including refusals. Correct means complete semantic answer; incomplete and substantive errors remain distinct. Semantic outcomes are null without preserved adjudications; recorded substring accuracy is separate. Unanswered, unadjudicated and other failures are explicitly tracked.
definitions.selection: Source-label precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN). Macro averages per-attempt metrics (equal case weights here); micro pools counts. Zero-denominator selection metrics are 0; absent measurements are null. Older runs may cover only scored attempts; measurement_coverage states the denominator.
definitions.latency: Seconds, all attempts; p50/p95 linearly interpolate at (n-1)q. Selection includes BGE and integration; end-to-end includes generation. Missing top-level end-to-end values are reconstructed only when both measured stage durations are present, matching the preserved summaries. Publication-only cached Cohere correction uses its original shared response records.
definitions.tokens: Reported API tokens summed across all attempts and provider tokenizers. Output includes Gemini thinking exactly once plus reported Claude output. Reasoning is null when not separately reported; null does not mean zero. Local token usage is unavailable. OpenAI output already includes reasoning; Cohere's absent token telemetry makes whole-pipeline totals null.
definitions.cost: USD estimated API cost at frozen reported rates, not invoices; per answer divides by attempts including refusals. Excludes local compute/hosting, credits, discounts, and unlogged retries. All estimates normalize measured usage to the October 8 snapshot; Cohere's illustrative rate is never used.
definitions.configuration: Configurations are identified by run and method, with no pooling across runs. Baseline is the within-run comparator; augmentation_target and optional baseline_configuration_id identify the actual preceding method. Replacement selectors are not mislabeled as augmentations. Family tags describe recorded components, with standalone Omneum shown as a reference in both views.

pricing.basis: standard paid tier; Gemini introductory rates through 2026-12-31; normalized October 8 comparison rates for all measured runs; not historical invoices

tied_diagnostic.attribution_limit: Equal selected evidence is a behavioral check, not identical execution code or interchangeable answer, timing, usage and cost measurements

lineage_audit.uncertainty: Every manifested run records a dirty checkout. Broad implementation fingerprints prove byte-set differences, not which algorithm or selector component changed. Exact executed source versions are null unless independently preserved; committed snapshots and behavioral matches are separate evidence.

publication_contract.scope: six authoritative matched runs, with the completed low-thinking Gemini generation recovery replacing the original Gemini comparison; canonical 24 cases, adjudications and necessary evidence
publication_contract.verification_limit: Public manifest projections are verified against their own hashes. Original manifest bytes and absolute identifiers remain private; their recorded hashes and execution fingerprints are retained, not reconstructed from public projections. Git lineage snapshots are preserved reference metadata, not exact dirty execution source.
